construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation created in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: One JSON envelope: schema_version, synthetic, residency, privacy, subscriber, usage_csv, fault_tickets, support_chats, products, preferences. All entity records carry residency and synthetic tags. Tickets, chats and CDRs reference the subscriber id.
shared_schema.usage_csv: Exact columns: record_id,subscriber_id,residency,synthetic,period,voice_minutes,data_mb. One monthly period YYYY-MM; empty body permitted. Decimal MB/GB/TB conversions.
shared_schema.support_chats: Structured transcripts with speaker (subscriber or agent) and text; raw transcript content never echoed.
shared_schema.products: Nonpersonal PLAN identifiers; numeric value/unit attributes; prices USD or cents, data MB/GB/TB, voice minutes/hours, reliability 0..100.
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, residency, privacy, usage_summary, required_allowances, support_summary, ranked comparison, recommended_product_id, notice. Errors: status=error with generic nonpersonal error, exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: Single validate_and_normalize layer: strict object fields, types, finite nonnegative quantities, duplicate IDs, CSV shape, shared residency, synthetic labels, subscriber references, explicit consent, purpose limitation, do_not_sell, billing reasons. CLI also rejects duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite constants.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated CSV usage aggregates and normalized plan attributes feed comparison in memory.
Monthly needs = maximum of stated minimum and observed monthly usage.
Comparison feeds deterministic weighted preference ranking and privacy-minimized JSON output.

behavior.normalization: Decimal data units normalized to GB, voice to minutes, monthly price to USD.
behavior.ranking: Price utility=min(1,budget/price), free=1. Data/voice utility=min(1,allowance/need), zero need=1. Reliability utility=percent/100. Weighted mean times 100, rounded to six decimals. Ties: lower price then product ID. Budget and allowance gaps are reported, not hard filters.
behavior.support_context: Fault tickets and chats are validated and counted; no inference of product network reliability from historical faults. Billing adjustment records are validated, never executed or subtracted from recurring prices.
behavior.privacy: Demonstrative GDPR/CCPA-oriented consent, purpose and no-sale gates; identifiers, chat text and billing reasons omitted from output. No compliance certification.
behavior.residency: EU or US envelope tag must match every record, including products and CDRs; output record summaries preserve it. Tag validation is not physical deployment residency enforcement.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly synthetic subscriber, fictional reserved phone number, intentionally synthetic zero-prefix IMEI, invented fault and chat. Seeded Random(132) randomized usage exercised by tests; example uses fixed synthetic volumes.
